game.name: Mamoru-kun Wa Norowarete Shimatta (Japan)
game.desc: Mamoru-kun Wa Norowarete Shimatta is an Xbox 360 port of an arcade game. It's a very colourful shoot'em up in which you control a spaceship on a vertical plane. On the menu, you'll have to kill lots of enemies and blow up monstrous bosses.
